name: Cheque Delivery 1 Code
definition: Specifies the method to be used in delivering a cheque to a party.

MLDB.name: Mail To Debtor
MLDB.definition: Cheque is to be sent through mail services to debtor.

MLCD.name: Mail To Creditor
MLCD.definition: Cheque is to be sent through mail services to creditor.

MLFA.name: Mail To Final Agent
MLFA.definition: Cheque is to be sent through mail services to creditor agent.

CRDB.name: Courier To Debtor
CRDB.definition: Cheque is to be sent through courier services to debtor.

CRCD.name: Courier To Creditor
CRCD.definition: Cheque is to be sent through courier services to creditor.

CRFA.name: Courier To Final Agent
CRFA.definition: Cheque is to be sent through courier services to creditor agent.

PUDB.name: Pick Up By Debtor
PUDB.definition: Cheque will be picked up by the debtor.

PUCD.name: Pick Up By Creditor
PUCD.definition: Cheque will be picked up by the creditor.

PUFA.name: Pick Up By Final Agent
PUFA.definition: Cheque will be picked up by the creditor agent.

RGDB.name: Registered Mail To Debtor
RGDB.definition: Cheque is to be sent through registered mail services to debtor.

RGCD.name: Registered Mail To Creditor
RGCD.definition: Cheque is to be sent through registered mail services to creditor.

RGFA.name: Registered Mail To Final Agent
RGFA.definition: Cheque is to be sent through registered mail services to creditor agent.
